title: Wall Mount Tumbler Toothbrush Holder 5-Inch Projection Solid Brass, Mambo Collection | Allied Brass
description:
Add space-saving storage at the sink with this wall mount tumbler toothbrush holder, crafted from solid brass. Designed for the Mambo collection, it fits transitional bathroom hardware plans and pairs easily with versatile bath accessories.

Highlights:
- Wall-mounted tumbler and toothbrush holder helps keep the vanity organized
- Solid brass construction for sturdy support
- Concealed screw mounting hardware for a clean look
- Multiple designer finish options available
- Installation hardware included

Specs:
- Category: Tumbler Toothbrush Holders
- Mounting type: Wall mount
- Dimensions: 4.5 in (L) x 3.5 in (W) x 4.7 in (H)
- Projection: 5 in
- Weight capacity: 6 lb
- Product weight: 2.4 lb
- Screw size: #8 X1 1/4"
- Included items: Toothbrush holder and all installation hardware
- Assembly required: No
- Warranty: Limited Lifetime Warranty
